newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - C&W options busy as shares jump.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - C&W options busy as shares jump.

text.p: UK equity options traded quietly by early afternoon on Friday and traders concentrated on special situations in underlying stocks, dealers said.
The jump in Cable & Wirelass shares was sufficient to attract buying of call options on the stock from traders hoping the stock will go higher.
One large deal was from a buyer of 1,000 July 550 calls at 11p and another deal was to buy 500 July 600 calls at 4p.
But on expectations the stock will be volatile, one trader bought strangles in C&W which involved buying 1,800 July 500 puts at 12p and 1,800 July 550 calls at 10p.
The strangles will make a profit at July expiry if the underlying shares either fall below 478p or go above 578p.
By 1350 GMT, C&W shares had surged 28p to 525-1/2p on hopes the company will make a deal with the Chinese authorities.

In food and drinks group Allied Domecq the main deal was also a long strangle and it concerned buying 300 October 420 puts at 15p as well as 300 October 460 calls at about 20p. The underlying shares were up 2p to 429p.
And the main deal in FTSE 100 index options was a long cylinder in which FTSE futures were bought which were covered by short calls. Puts were bought to complete the hedge.
The deal was to buy 1,100 September 4425 puts at 73p, to sell 1,100 September 4525 calls at 199-1/2p and to buy FTSE futures.
If the market rallies, the long futures position will make a profit but above 4525 the short calls may be assigned and the position will have to be closed.
On the other hand, if the market falls below 4425 the long puts can be exercised to limit further losses from the futures position.
At 1350 GMT, cash FTSE was up 42.3 at 4618.5 and June futures were up 51 points at 4627.
